title: C Programming Foundations: Compilation, Memory Safety, and a File-Backed Tracker
description: A beginner C course covering translation, diagnostics, types, safe input, control flow, arrays, functions, pointers, structs, file I/O, testing, and a file-backed progress-tracker capstone.
prerequisites: Ability to create and save a text file

Use types, control flow, arrays, functions, and pointers within documented bounds and lifetimes
Build and test a modular struct-based progress tracker with validated file input

lessons.title: Compiling C and Reading Diagnostics
lessons.summary: Understand source, preprocessing, compilation, linking, executable output, warnings, and a repeatable build-run-debug cycle.
objectives: Explain and apply Compiling C and Reading Diagnostics
Compile and test behavior with warnings enabled

blocks.heading: Core model
blocks.bodyMarkdown: A C implementation translates source through preprocessing, compilation, assembly, and linking. Use a command such as `cc -std=c17 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic main.c -o main` so warnings expose suspicious conversions and unused values. The compiler checks syntax and types but cannot prove every memory access is valid. Linker errors usually indicate a declared function or object has no matching definition. Read the first relevant diagnostic, correct one cause, rebuild, and never run a stale executable after compilation fails.

blocks.heading: Core model
blocks.bodyMarkdown: C objects have declared types that determine representation and operations. Integer division truncates toward zero, so cast before division when a fraction is required. `sizeof` reports storage in bytes as `size_t`. `printf` and `scanf` format specifiers must match argument types; a mismatch can cause undefined behavior. For robust interactive input, read a line with `fgets`, then parse with `strtol` while checking the end pointer and range. Initialize objects before reading them and never assume failed input leaves a useful value.

blocks.heading: Core model
blocks.bodyMarkdown: In C, zero is false and nonzero is true, while relational and logical operators produce 0 or 1. `&&` and `||` short-circuit, which can guard a later expression such as division or pointer access. Assignment `=` and equality `==` are different; enable warnings and place intentional assignments outside conditions. Use `else if` for mutually exclusive ranges and `switch` for discrete integral cases. Every threshold needs tests below, at, and above it. Parenthesize mixed conditions when the intended grouping is not immediately obvious.

blocks.heading: Core model
blocks.bodyMarkdown: C arrays contain a fixed number of adjacent elements and do not carry their length into a called function. Valid indexes run from zero through length minus one. Compute a local array count with `sizeof array / sizeof array[0]` only where `array` is still an array, not a pointer parameter. Use `size_t` for sizes and indexes. A loop invariant states what remains valid before each iteration; conditions such as `i < count` protect bounds. Out-of-range access is undefined behavior, not a guaranteed exception.

blocks.heading: Core model
blocks.bodyMarkdown: C passes arguments by value. To let a function modify a caller object, pass its address and dereference a validated pointer. A pointer stores an address; it is not an array length or ownership guarantee. Test against `NULL` before dereferencing when null is permitted. Use `const int *` when a function may read but not modify the pointed-to integer. Never return a pointer to an automatic local object because its lifetime ends when the function returns. Document who owns allocated memory and who must release it.

blocks.heading: Core model
blocks.bodyMarkdown: A struct groups related fields into one record; an enum gives meaningful names to integral states. Fixed character arrays require space for the terminating null character. Copy and format with bounded functions, always checking truncation and return values. File functions return status: verify `fopen`, check each read or write, and call `fclose`. Text persistence needs a documented format and validation when loaded because files are untrusted input. Separate parsing, domain updates, calculations, and presentation so each function has a testable contract.
